summary: You can stop Meta from AI-summarising the comments on your own posts. You cannot stop it anywhere else, and the setting is four levels deep in a menu nobody visits.

steps.path: Menu (bottom right) → Settings & Privacy → Audiences and Visibility → Posts → turn off "Allow Comment Summaries on Your Posts"

collateral: only applies to your own posts — summaries still appear on everyone else's
no equivalent control for feed-level AI features
whyTheyDidIt: A narrow opt-out is enough to answer press questions without denting the feature's reach.

sources.label: Consumer Reports — disable AI comment summaries on the Facebook app
